speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing weakness and fatigue; to help me identify the cause, could you tell me how long these symptoms have been present and if you have noticed any accompanying signs like shortness of breath or weight changes?

speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. She mentions experiencing these symptoms currently. The patient has been traveling, hiking, and camping recently and notes having had multiple illnesses in the recent past.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (Myalgic Encephalomyelitis)
Given your age, recent travel and hiking, and multiple illnesses, I need to rule out other causes. Do you have a fever, headache, or sore throat alongside this fatigue, and does resting fully relieve your symptoms?
